name: the_trade_desk-mcp
description: The Trade Desk (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget. Every tool maps to a documen

platform_mcp_the_trade_desk_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_THE_TRADE_DESK_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_the_trade_desk_api_token.description: Platform API token generated in OpenTTD > Access Management > Generate Token / Key (Application: Platform API; lifetime one week to one year), sent as the TTD-Auth header. Short-lived tokens from POST /v3/authentication also work until they expire.

platform_mcp_the_trade_desk_partner_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_THE_TRADE_DESK_PARTNER_ID
platform_mcp_the_trade_desk_partner_id.description: Your Partner ID (e.g. from POST /v3/partner/query); list_accounts lists the advertisers of this partner (POST /v3/advertiser/query/partner needs PartnerId).

tools.name: me
tools.description: POST /v3/partner/query {PageStartIndex: 0, PageSize: 1}: 'Get all Partners that are accessible' to the token; account.Result[0].PartnerId is the partner id to configure.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: POST /v3/advertiser/query/partner {PartnerId (config partner_id), PageStartIndex: 0, PageSize: 100}: 'Get Advertisers that belong to the specified Partner' (first 100). The advertiser id is the account_id for list_campaigns.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: POST /v3/campaign/query/advertiser {AdvertiserId, PageStartIndex (zero-based offset), PageSize, Availabilities}: 'Get a page of Campaigns that belong to the specified Advertiser'. `status` is an Availability (Available or Archived). `budget` is the campaign's total Budget (Money {Amount, CurrencyCode}); DailyBudget, PacingMode and CampaignFlights are in raw.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PUT /v3/campaign {CampaignId, DailyBudget: {Amount, CurrencyCode}} ('Update an existing campaign'). DailyBudget is Money: Amount is a decimal in the advertiser's currency and CurrencyCode (e.g. USD) is REQUIRED, so pass `currency`. TTD: 'For campaigns with multiple flights, this property becomes read-only and its value is determined by individual flight budget values' - such campaigns are rejected; change the flight budget in the platform instead.
